# apple_app_store_version_routing_app_coverage (Resource)

Uploads the GeoJSON file of the regions a routing app covers for an App Store version. A version has one; creating this resource replaces an existing file. A changed file is uploaded as a new one, which replaces the resource. Destroying the resource deletes the file. Import it by ID; the next apply then uploads the configured file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_routing_app_coverage" "regions" {
  version_id = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  file       = "${path.module}/routing/coverage.geojson"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) Path of the file to upload. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.
- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the routing app coverage file.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_routing_app_coverage.regions
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the routing app coverage file.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version_routing_app_coverage.regions 1234567890
```
